t: Light up your world with festive, bright lights. These lights come in 4 styles: $(li)Classic (Large bulbs) $(li)Mini (Small bulbs) $(li)Icicle $(li)Twinkling Icicle
用喜庆明亮的灯具点亮你的世界！这些灯具共分4种样式：$(li)经典款（大灯泡） $(li)迷你款（小灯泡） $(li)冰凌款 $(li)闪烁冰凌款

All light versions come in a set of white, or a set of multi-colors. For the Classic and Mini styles, there are 8 shapes: $(li)Horizontal $(li)Diagonal (Left) $(li)Diagonal (Right) $(li)Vertical (Left) $(li)Vertical (Right) $(li)Vertical Corner (Left) $(li)Vertical Corner (Right) $(li)Cap (Roof Peak)
所有灯具版本均提供纯白套装或多彩套装。经典款与迷你款共含8种造型：$(li)水平型 $(li)左对角线型 $(li)右对角线型 $(li)竖直左型 $(li)竖直右型 $(li)竖直转角左型 $(li)竖直转角右型 $(li)封顶型（屋顶峰顶）
For the Icicle and Twinkling Icicle lights, there are 4 shapes: $(li)Horizontal $(li)Diagonal (Left) $(li)Diagonal (Right) $(li)Cap (Roof Peak)
冰凌灯与闪烁冰凌灯共提供4种造型：$(li)水平型 $(li)左对角线型 $(li)右对角线型 $(li)封顶型（屋顶峰顶）
Horizontal lights will connect in and around corners. They are placed similarly to vines.
水平灯具可在角落内外自然连接，其摆放方式与藤蔓类似。
Diagonal Icicle/Twinkling Icicle Lights have a somewhat odd placement and will extend under the block they are placed on. This is done so that they connect better when placed.
对角线冰凌/闪烁冰凌灯具的摆放位置略显特殊，会向下延伸至其所在方块下方。此举旨在提升相邻摆放时的连接效果。
Vertical Lights will line up with the left or right side of a block.
竖直灯具将与方块的左侧或右侧对齐。
Vertical Corner Lights will create two sections of lights at a 90 degree angle, lining up with the left side or right side of a block.
竖直转角灯具将在90度夹角处形成两段灯具，分别与方块的左侧或右侧对齐。
Cap lights can be used to fill in a gap that is left when a roof peak has an odd number of blocks. $(br2) Read on for the recipes...
封顶型灯具可用于填补屋顶峰顶因方块数量为奇数而留下的空缺。$(br2)更多配方请继续阅读……

Now you will craft the base type of lights. These are what you will use to create the placement shapes that were mentioned previously.$(br2)There is a different base type for every style of lights: Classic, Mini, Icicle, and Twinkling Icicle.$(br2)Special note: The Mini base types are also used for the Christmas Trees, and are named as such.
现在你将合成基础灯具。这些是此前提及的各类摆放造型所必需的基础组件。$(br2)每种灯具样式（经典款、迷你款、冰凌款、闪烁冰凌款）均有专属的基础类型。$(br2)特别说明：迷你基础类型亦用于圣诞树，故以此命名。

You have your base lights, now you're ready to craft the light blocks.$(br2)Horizontal and Cap shapes have standard crafting recipes. Shapes defined as 'Left' or 'Right' will require a template to craft.$(br2)To craft a template light recipe, just place 3 of your base lights along with the correct template into the crafting table.
你已拥有基础灯具，现在可以开始合成灯具方块了。$(br2)水平型与封顶型采用标准合成配方；定义为“左”或“右”的造型则需借助模板合成。$(br2)合成模板灯具配方时，仅需将3个基础灯具与对应模板一同放入工作台即可。

Only one example of each type will be shown here, but the recipe shapes are the same for all of the lights.$(br2)The only exceptions are Icicles and Twinkling Icicles, which do not have any vertical or corner versions.
此处仅展示每种类型的单个示例，但所有灯具的配方造型均保持一致。$(br2)唯一例外是冰凌款与闪烁冰凌款，二者不提供竖直型或转角型。
